summary: The old harness links the former root archive path, while the changed library target is under src/lib/. This focused claim requires an update.

assessment.necessity_reason: Linking libcares is required to build this fuzz target. The changed Automake target is in src/lib/, but the fixed harness still names the root archive.

before.requirement: Link the archive from the root libcares.la target.
before.reason: The root Makefile defines libcares.la, matching the harness's root archive operand. This assesses the path, not a demonstrated successful build.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: The former project test link recipe also names the root library target.

after.requirement: Link the archive from the src/lib libcares.la target.
after.reason: The library target is now defined in src/lib/, and the root Makefile descends into subdirectories. The harness still supplies the root .libs/libcares.a path.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: The changed root build delegates to subdirectories.
The changed project test link recipe names src/lib/libcares.la.

assessment.comparison_reason: The same root archive operand corresponds to the before target location but misses the after target location.
